documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a 3% growth in reported revenues for FY19, or 13% adjusted for changes in billing methodology, with domestic revenues impacted by severe weather in Q4 and international revenues crossing the $20 million milestone. The company achieved a gross margin expansion of over 600 basis points and a more than doubled profit after tax during FY19, while starting FY20 with double-digit summer growth. Management outlined expectations to spend Rs. 30-35 crore in capex during the year and plans to implement price increases in the second half due to higher milk prices. Vadilal Industries reported robust financial performance for Q3 and 9M FY19, driven by strong growth in both domestic and international segments along with expanding margins and reduced debt.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore in capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management sees another good year in FY20 as the company leverages the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $20 million milestone, driven by strong demand within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and other geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19. International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is now reverting to historical trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the international business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY20 is approximately Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
capex_expansion.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and larger contribution from international operations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Visibility of stable costs is covered till Q2 based on raw material purchase and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that international ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins.
margins_costs.quote: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, which is also helping improve profits while increasing utilization of current capacities.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

orders_capacity.claim: Production facilities include Bareilly with 150,000 liters per day capacity, Dharampur with 33,000 kgs per day, and Pundhra with 230,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote:
Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005
Dharampur, Gujarat 33,000 kgs per day Processed foods ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6
Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

management_commitments.claim: Management will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels now.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to invest in production capacity, technology, brand and distribution.
management_commitments.quote: Will continue to invest in production capacity, technology, brand and distribution

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they remain committed to expand the distribution network judiciously.
management_commitments.quote: we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
